$comment: maxLiveReviewRounds caps how many review rounds (review-job / review-loop-cli processes) may run on the host at once; the review daemon dispatches no new review while that many are live, and owed reviews stay queued. Raised from 3 to 8 for the primary host, under the operator's authority on 2026-11-16. It is fork A of the load-limits decision card x5n902w (PR #6951). Hard range: 1..16; the configured default remains 8. Env override WE_REVIEW_MAX_LIVE_ROUNDS uses the same range. host.maxReviewDispatchPerTick independently paces starts (1..8), rather than limiting total live rounds. Lane shortages defer owed reviews until capacity is acquirable. Revert: set it back to 3.
